name: 107 - DB - Add Channel Gateway and Security Structures

parameters.query:
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS channel_gateway_clients (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

    clinic_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES clinics(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    client_name TEXT NOT NULL,

    channel TEXT NOT NULL
        CHECK (
            channel IN (
                'whatsapp',
                'sms',
                'phone',
                'telegram',
                'webchat',
                'manual',
                'api',
                'email',
                'web_push',
                'in_app'
            )
        ),

    provider_name TEXT,

    auth_mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'api_key'
        CHECK (
            auth_mode IN (
                'api_key',
                'provider_signature',
                'development_none'
            )
        ),

    api_key_hash TEXT,

    signature_verifier_url TEXT,
    signature_credential_reference TEXT,

    allowed_ip_addresses TEXT[] NOT NULL
        DEFAULT ARRAY[]::TEXT[],

    rate_limit_requests INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 120
        CHECK (
            rate_limit_requests BETWEEN 1 AND 100000
        ),

    rate_limit_window_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 60
        CHECK (
            rate_limit_window_seconds BETWEEN 1 AND 86400
        ),

    replay_window_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 86400
        CHECK (
            replay_window_seconds BETWEEN 60 AND 604800
        ),

    enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,

    metadata JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::JSONB,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    UNIQUE (
        clinic_id,
        client_name,
        channel
    )
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS channel_gateway_requests (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

    clinic_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES clinics(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    client_id BIGINT
        REFERENCES channel_gateway_clients(id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL,

    gateway_event_type TEXT NOT NULL
        CHECK (
            gateway_event_type IN (
                'inbound_message',
                'delivery_status'
            )
        ),

    channel TEXT NOT NULL,

    external_event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    external_message_id TEXT,

    request_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    replay_key TEXT NOT NULL,

    source_ip TEXT,
    request_timestamp TIMESTAMPTZ,

    authentication_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
        CHECK (
            authentication_status IN (
                'pending',
                'allowed',
                'denied',
                'not_configured'
            )
        ),

    rate_limit_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
        CHECK (
            rate_limit_status IN (
                'pending',
                'allowed',
                'blocked'
            )
        ),

    processing_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'received'
        CHECK (
            processing_status IN (
                'received',
                'accepted',
                'duplicate',
                'rate_limited',
                'authentication_failed',
                'processed',
                'failed'
            )
        ),

    result JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::JSONB,

    received_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    processed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    UNIQUE (
        replay_key
    )
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS channel_rate_limit_counters (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

    client_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES channel_gateway_clients(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    window_start TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    window_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL,

    request_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
        CHECK (
            request_count >= 0
        ),

    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    UNIQUE (
        client_id,
        window_start,
        window_seconds
    )
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS inbound_channel_messages (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

    gateway_request_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES channel_gateway_requests(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    clinic_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES clinics(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    client_id BIGINT
        REFERENCES channel_gateway_clients(id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL,

    channel TEXT NOT NULL,

    external_conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    external_message_id TEXT NOT NULL,

    sender TEXT,
    message_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    message_text TEXT,

    attachments JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::JSONB,
    normalized_payload JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::JSONB,
    raw_payload JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::JSONB,

    language TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown',

    processing_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'received'
        CHECK (
            processing_status IN (
                'received',
                'forwarded',
                'processed',
                'failed'
            )
        ),

    orchestrator_response JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::JSONB,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    processed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    UNIQUE (
        clinic_id,
        channel,
        external_message_id
    )
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS provider_callback_events (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

    gateway_request_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES channel_gateway_requests(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    clinic_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES clinics(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    client_id BIGINT
        REFERENCES channel_gateway_clients(id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL,

    provider_name TEXT,
    channel TEXT NOT NULL,

    callback_type TEXT NOT NULL
        CHECK (
            callback_type IN (
                'inbound_message',
                'delivery_status'
            )
        ),

    external_event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    external_message_id TEXT,

    normalized_event JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::JSONB,
    raw_event JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::JSONB,

    processing_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'received'
        CHECK (
            processing_status IN (
                'received',
                'forwarded',
                'processed',
                'failed'
            )
        ),

    processing_result JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::JSONB,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    processed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    UNIQUE (
        clinic_id,
        provider_name,
        external_event_id
    )
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_gateway_clients_lookup
ON channel_gateway_clients(
    clinic_id,
    client_name,
    channel,
    enabled
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_gateway_requests_recent
ON channel_gateway_requests(
    clinic_id,
    received_at DESC
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_gateway_requests_status
ON channel_gateway_requests(
    processing_status,
    received_at
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_rate_limit_counters_recent
ON channel_rate_limit_counters(
    client_id,
    window_start DESC
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_inbound_channel_messages_recent
ON inbound_channel_messages(
    clinic_id,
    channel,
    created_at DESC
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_provider_callbacks_recent
ON provider_callback_events(
    clinic_id,
    callback_type,
    created_at DESC
);

SELECT
    TRUE AS success,
    'migration_completed' AS result,
    'ساختار Channel Gateway، Authentication، Replay Protection و Rate Limiting ایجاد شد.' AS message;

parameters.content:
## فقط یک‌بار اجرا شود

ساختارهای ایجادشده:
- Gateway Clients
- Gateway Request Ledger
- Rate Limit Counters
- Inbound Message Registry
- Provider Callback Registry

API Key خام ذخیره نمی‌شود؛ فقط SHA-256 Hash در دیتابیس قرار می‌گیرد.
